headline: 150 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Hawk Fire in NV, threatening 30,000 structures.

active_threats.name: Hawk
active_threats.narrative: The Hawk Fire in Washoe County, NV has burned 15,051 acres and is 0% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **30,000 structures threatened**. 720 personnel are assigned. Forecast winds will be locally gusty (up to 29 mph, sustained near 16) with humidity as low as 20%. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind (W) is not currently aligned toward Verdi CDP, the nearest community of size, 2 miles away.

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over OK, TX: Dallas city, Fort Worth city, Arlington city, Plano city, and Frisco city and 25 other communities sit under SPC's **Elevated** fire-weather category and NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (days 1,2,3,7). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 2% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
